title: Reinforcement learning-based decision support system for COVID-19.
summary: Full Methods and Results describe a Q-learning reinforcement-learning controller evaluated in COVID-19 epidemic-model simulations/case studies under hospital-saturation and intervention-cost constraints; it reports simulated control-policy outcomes. Treat as a bounded computational epidemiology finding, not observed clinical effectiveness.
